verdict.rationale: Bolna's official MCP server lets Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, or any MCP client act directly on a user's Bolna account, so the account can be driven with natural-language commands. Agent Studio adds native natural-language agent creation, turning a short use-case description into a call-ready agent. Missing for 10: documentation of which operations the MCP tools expose (e.g. managing calls, batches, numbers), an in-product natural-language command interface beyond agent creation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
